name: MAHSING
recent: Mah Sing 近期完成 Kepong 的 M Nova 项目（发展总值 RM7.9 亿），比原定提前交付；同时与 KLK Land 为 RM22 亿的 MS Industrial Park @ Kulai 开设销售展厅，首期 1A 认购率超过 90%。公司也宣布多项土地收购，包括 Semenyih 275 英亩土地（RM2.735 亿）、Kulai 419 英亩土地（RM2.739 亿）及 Ampang 14.38 英亩土地（RM1.862 亿），部分收购的期限已延长。
notable: 完成 Kepong 的 M Nova 项目，发展总值 RM7.9 亿，提前交付。
与 KLK Land 为 RM22 亿的 MS Industrial Park @ Kulai 开设销售展厅，首期 1A 认购率超过 90%。
宣布收购 Semenyih 275 英亩土地（RM2.735 亿）、Kulai 419 英亩土地（RM2.739 亿）及 Ampang 14.38 英亩土地（RM1.862 亿）。
risks: Semenyih 275 英亩土地的收购条件期限已延长一个月至 2026 年 12 月 2 日。
Kulai 419 英亩土地收购的剩余先决条件期限已延长至 2026 年 12 月 21 日。
earnings: 2026 年第二季营收为 MYR 656.3 百万，按季增长 16.5%，按年增长 16.0%；净利为 MYR 72.5 百万，按季增长 6.5%，按年增长 9.8%；净利率为 11.0%，低于上一季的 12.1%。

recent_en: Mah Sing recently completed its M Nova project in Kepong (GDV RM790 million) ahead of schedule, and opened a sales gallery with KLK Land for the RM2.2 billion MS Industrial Park @ Kulai, with Phase 1A over 90% taken up. The company also announced several land acquisitions, including 275 acres in Semenyih (RM273.5 million), 419 acres in Kulai (RM273.9 million) and 14.38 acres in Ampang (RM186.2 million), with deadlines for some acquisitions extended.
notable_en: Completed the M Nova project in Kepong with GDV of RM790 million, delivered ahead of schedule.
Opened a sales gallery with KLK Land for the RM2.2 billion MS Industrial Park @ Kulai, with Phase 1A over 90% taken up.
Announced acquisitions of 275 acres in Semenyih (RM273.5 million), 419 acres in Kulai (RM273.9 million) and 14.38 acres in Ampang (RM186.2 million).
risks_en: The conditional period for the 275-acre Semenyih land acquisition has been extended by one month to 2 December 2026.
The deadline for fulfilling remaining conditions precedent for the 419-acre Kulai land acquisition has been extended to 21 December 2026.
earnings_en: 2Q2026 revenue was MYR 656.3 million, up 16.5% QoQ and 16.0% YoY; net income was MYR 72.5 million, up 6.5% QoQ and 9.8% YoY; net margin was 11.0%, down from 12.1% in the previous quarter.
